title: PI Daily Insights: Sunday 23 August 2026
method: Eight Tier 1/2 searches + six Tier 1 scrapes; several searches returned bot challenges, so direct source pages are the evidence base.
summary: 2 Band A items: a Flinders pier restoration call and a local-business electrification webinar.

actToday.title: Community and Council call to finish Flinders pier restoration
actToday.description: The Shire says community and Council are calling to finish the State Government's Flinders pier restoration project; 13 standalone wooden piles remain offshore.
actToday.interpretation: Timely local public-interest story with a strong visual and location angle. Keep any coverage factual and attribute government-project claims.
actToday.recommendation: Telegram PI group plus journal short, subject to human editorial approval.

actToday.title: Lunch and Learn: Electrifying Local Businesses
actToday.description: The Shire lists a free 24 August lunchtime webinar for businesses on switching from gas to electric alternatives, including costs and government subsidies.
actToday.interpretation: A practical, time-sensitive B2B utility item; verify start time and registration details first.
actToday.recommendation: Telegram PI group plus LinkedIn-only B2B note after verification.

news.item: Illegal dumpers fined after Shire investigations
news.note: Shire says officers issued fines for unlawful waste disposal and littering. Bank for a practical waste-disposal explainer; verify details in the primary release.
